title: August 2026
campaignIntro: This SEO growth initiative is focused on strengthening Oatley Vigmond’s visibility across Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other emerging AI-powered search platforms.

Our ongoing work includes technical SEO, AI search optimization (AEO), geographic search optimization (GEO), content architecture, internal linking, conversion tracking, and marketing automation to increase qualified case inquiries across Ontario.
monthlyRecap: August focused on improving the site’s technical foundation, crawl efficiency, content relationships, and semantic clarity. We cleaned up the XML sitemap, strengthened internal links across key legal content, refined legacy redirects, improved the homepage heading hierarchy, and enhanced the accessibility tree so search engines, screen readers, and AI-based agents can interpret the site more clearly.

recap: August’s audit maintains a 100/100 on-page SEO score, with organic monthly traffic at 6,109, 1,932 organic keywords, and 5,161 backlinks. The audit crawled 9,597 pages and identified 48 issues.
